authority: Mandatory completed-audio long-silence inspection through the existing production owner.

dependencies: The separately reviewed production.inspect_completed_silence backend must be composed before execution.
scope.shared_documentation_owner: The Studio component maintains AUDIO_STUDIO_V3.md; this component carries the CLI example without editing that shared file.

interface.example_note: Replace RUN_KEY with the actual selected completed-production directory. The two numeric values are explicit inspection criteria, not a universal quality judgement.
interface.criteria_validation: The shared production service enforces finite threshold -120..0 dBFS, finite minimum >0..86400 seconds, interval cap 1..1000 and optional exact lowercase 64-hex run identity.
interface.output: Unmodified JSON-safe shared-service report on stdout; status on stderr.
interface.cancellation: Existing SIGINT event, restored previous handler, exit 130 with status cancelled. A stop observed after service return cannot emit a complete report.

boundaries: The selected operation branches before batch, voice, model, FFmpeg, broker and profile discovery in run_audio.
The public entrypoint retains its existing optional bundled-runtime/installation-lease wrapper.
Rendering and inference-specific flags are refused for inspection; both numerical criteria must be explicit.
No modification of completion manifest, source plan, completed media, cache or old receipts is introduced.
The CLI delegates retained-media identity, sample scanning, mutation refusal and report bounds to the same shared production service used by the desktop.
authored_regressions: Exact operation/criteria and unrelated-authority refusals use the public CLI before optional runtime activation.

A real pause-only producer completion is inspected through the actual shared backend; its JSON is emitted unchanged and exact 1600-frame/8000-Hz/stereo interval, source/media hashes and all retained bytes are checked.
The real-completion fixture uses FFmpeg only to create its retained source; inspection forbids registry, FFmpeg resolver, render, resource-broker, profile and library-root selection.

Two explicit signal-callback boundary fixtures exercise during-inspection and after-service-return cancellation, handler restoration, no complete output and byte preservation; they do not claim native signal delivery.
An invalid selected completion is refused through the public CLI and actual backend without repairing or starting an engine.

performed: Exact literal source inverse comparison in JavaScript
validation.required_next: Compose the reviewed backend and this CLI source, then execute all old and added cases under the existing source and isolated installed gates.
